questions.question: 8 is related to 59 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 9 is related to 76. To which of the following is 25 related to, following the same logic?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **Second number = (First number)² - 5**

**8: 59**

→ 59 = (8)² - 5

→ 59 = 64 - 5

**9: 76**

→ 76 = (9)2 - 5

→ 76 = 81 - 5

Similarly,

**25: ?**

→ ? = (25)2 - 5

→ ? = 625 - 5 = 620

Hence, the correct answer is **"620"**.

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion/s logically follow/s from the given statements.

**Statements:** All shoes are leather. Some leather are belts. Some belts are gold.

**Conclusion I: **Some shoes are belts.

**Conclusion II:** All belts are gold.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Statement:

All shoes are leather.

Some leather are belts.

Some belts are gold.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09784da7a63edf679b47128771aa047828e324397988ae0999a400e94cab0c5f.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some shoes are belts → **False **(There is no direct relation is given between shoes and belts. So, it can be possible only.)

II. All belts are gold → **False **(It is given that some belt are gold. No relation is given about all belt and gold so it can be possible only.)

So, **neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is*** 'Option 1'.***

questions.question:
If 'I' stands for '+', 'J' stands for '×', 'K' stands for '÷' and 'L' stands for '-', what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

(48 K 8) J 4 L 15 I (12 J 3) I 20 = ?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: (48 K 8) J 4 L 15 I (12 J 3) I 20 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Alphabet
 I
 J
 K
 L
 
 
 
 

 **Meaning**
 +
 ×
 ÷
 -
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ (__**48 ÷ 8**__) × 4 - 15 + (12 × 3) + 20

⇒ 6 × 4 - 15 + (__12 × 3__) + 20

⇒ __**6 × 4**__ - 15 + 36 + 20

⇒ __**24**__ - 15 __**+ 36 + **____**20**__

⇒ __**80 - 15**__ = 65.

Hence, the correct option is **"Option 2"**.

questions.question:
D, E, F, G, H, I, J and K are sitting around a square table facing the center of the table. Some of them are sitting at the corners while some are sitting at the exact center of the sides. K sits third to the right of I. K sits at one of the corners. E sits second to the left of G. G sits at any of the corners. E is an immediate neighbour of I and D. F sits third to the right of J. H is the immediate neighbour of F and K.

How many people sit between I and F, when counted from the left of I?
questions.solution:
According to the given information,

1) K sits third to the right of I.

2) K sits at one of the corners. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1852acc7c53ec344f98885afb52ff090b39b744de0a64522ce78270504cd928.png] 

3) E is an immediate neighbour of I and D.

4) E sits second to the left of G.

5) G sits at any of the corners.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3753491dc6d359ea7873235706dae6cc86842e4586ff5b8f1c5b9270297f8e10.png] 

6) H is the immediate neighbour of F and K.

7) F sits third to the right of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c7b60ddf730a6f39bb71ba087d6488d03a017918e3c4002ca66f199ce5c6d8f.png] 

Here, we can see that two people sit between I and F, when counted from the left of I.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Two"**.

questions.question: If 11 December 2009 is a Friday, then what will be the day of the week on 18 December 2014?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: Logic: A normal year advances the day of the year by 1 day. And a leap year advances the day of the year by 2 days.

If 11 December 2009 is a Friday, then 18 December 2009 is → **Friday + 7 = Friday. **

Number of days between 18 December 2009 and 18 December 2014 = (1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1) = 6

So, the day on 18 December 2014 is → **(Friday + 6)** = Thursday.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Thursday"**.
